title: Probabilistic shadow-scan for CI performance gating
creator: Riley Kapoor
description: Goal: Add a probabilistic ‘shadow-scan’ harness into PR CI that runs lightweight, representative microbenchmarks to detect token/sec and p95 regressions before merges. This ticket implements a low-cost shadow runner that executes on a stratified subset of PR traffic shapes (short/medium/long sequences, chat vs. single-turn) and compares results against an adaptive rolling baseline with Bayesian change-point detection. The focus is minimizing false positives while surfacing true regressions early, and producing actionable debugging artifacts (trace + kernel selection + input sample) attached to the PR.
acceptance_criteria: Shadow-scan job runs on PRs and completes within configured CI budget (<= 90s wall) for normal PRs
For each run, records: tokens/sec, p95 latency, sample traces, model variant, kernel selection and batch config
Baseline is maintained as a 30-day rolling window with per-slice summary stats and predictive uncertainty
Bayesian online change-point detector flags regressions at specified confidence thresholds and posts a deterministic PASS/FAIL to the PR checks API
Artifacts (mini trace + 3 failing inputs + perf dashboard link) are uploaded to the PR and the perf dashboard for triage
False-positive rate observed in 2-week pilot < 3% while true-positive detection for injected 10% p95 regressions > 90%
Runbook created for oncall to interpret flags and escalate to runtime/infra owners
tasks: Design stratified microbenchmark suite (sequence length buckets, prompt templates, chat vs single-turn)
Implement lightweight runner that replays synthetic workload against model snapshot with isolated KV cache
Integrate Bayesian online change-point detection library and tune priors for tokens/sec and p95
Wire results into CI (GitHub checks) with artifact upload and perf link
Build dashboard slice view and historical baseline visualization in Console
Run 2-week canary against active PR traffic and collect metrics for calibration
Document rollout plan and create oncall runbook
comments: 2025-01-12: Initial spike implemented — runner prototype executes a stratified 12-query suite and returns tokens/sec. Observed high variance on long-sequence slices; need KV cache warmup policy.
2025-01-20: Design review with PM & SRE — agreed to limit CI probe to 3 total slices per PR and fall back to async nightly probe for heavy suites.
2025-01-28: Bayesian detector integrated; preliminary priors chosen based on 60 days of historic CI baselines. Still tuning false-positive threshold.
2025-02-03: Pilot started for eng team PRs only. Several noisy flags traced to ephemeral infra interference — adding smoothing and resource-stability gating.
2025-02-05: Updated detector config and reduced CI job concurrency; planning dashboard prototype demo next week.
